import hashlib, os, urllib.request
root = r'C:\banyan-farm\jerryexpref-0821'

url = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olegmalk/banyan-city/main/review/ep2-goblin-design-0819/adult-b19-0819.jpg'
with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=180) as r:
    blob = r.read()
got = hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()
if got != '1a71fb920807bd15399f8a516d3b26979fd65f7b122a11b49a74f0fa8bc5c2eb':
    print('!! tile sha', got); raise SystemExit(1)
tile = os.path.join(root, 'tile.jpg')
open(tile, 'wb').write(blob)
im = Image.open(tile)
m = Image.new('L', im.size, 0)
d = ImageDraw.Draw(m)
d.rectangle([200, 336, 305, 366], fill=255)
d.rectangle([222, 416, 300, 440], fill=255)
m.save(os.path.join(root, 'mask.png'))
print('staged tile', got, im.size, 'mask drawn')

import glob, hashlib, os, shutil
src = 'C:/banyan-farm/jerryexpref-0821'
dst = 'C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/ep2-jerry-expref-0821'
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
files = sorted(glob.glob(src + '/expref-*.png')
               + glob.glob(src + '/mask.png')
               + glob.glob(src + '/prompt.txt')
               + glob.glob(src + '/negative.txt'))
lines = []
for f in files:
    shutil.copy2(f, dst)
    c = os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(f))
    with open(c, 'rb') as fh:
        lines.append(hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest() + '  '
                     + os.path.basename(f))
with open(os.path.join(dst, 'ep2-jerry-expref-0821.sha256'), 'w', newline='\n') as fh:
    fh.write('\n'.join(sorted(lines)) + '\n')
print('published', len(files), '->', dst)
raise SystemExit(0 if len(files) >= 5 else 1)
